verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Bridge (part of this Stripe crypto evidence pack) documenting webhooks that deliver real-time notifications of account events. That shows outbound event callbacks exist, but nothing covers signatures or the specific money-movement events the story names. Missing for 10: evidence of webhook signing/verification, documented event types for payment confirmed, payout settled and conversion executed, webhook coverage for Stripe-side stablecoin payments/payouts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, money movement emits signed webhooks — payment confirmed, payout settled, conversion executed — so my system tracks state without polling chains or dashboards

citations.quote: Bridge webhooks allow you to receive real-time notifications when events occur in your Bridge account.
